TRANSFORM YOUR VAN INTO
THE IDEAL TOOLBOX.
Properly secure all cargo.
THE CAVERNOUS INTERIOR OF CARGO VAN reflects an intelligently designed space you’ll make better through a wide variety of upfits and options.
Why does Ram ProMaster® Cargo Van work so well? Multiple reasons. Dash-to-front-axle lengths are kept short to maximize interior volume. Side walls flirt with
a practical 90 degrees, enabling easy shelf installation. Side doors (up to 49.2 inches wide) and rear doors (61.5 inches wide; up to 70.5 inches high; and opening
to 260 degrees) are huge; both accommodate standard-size pallets. Three wheelbases and four workable lengths (that max out with the extended version
reaching 250.5 inches) supply abundant space and a work-ready floor length. Finally, factor in two roof heights, depending on model: the Standard Roof with a
65.4-inch interior height, or the available High Roof, offering 76-inch floor-to-ceiling convenience, and which is standard on all ProMaster Windowed Van models.
BEST-IN-CLASS ASSETS ABOUND. Van models feature the lowest load floor height in the class1—it’s an easy-in 21 inches, with a
best-in-class1 cargo width between the wheel wells and a best-in-class1 turning diameter: on 118-inch wheelbase models, it’s a street-
friendly 36.3 feet. Maneuverability and handling are exemplary. Front-wheel-drive engineering pays off by lowering the platform and eliminating
the characteristic “hump” so typical of rear-wheel-drive vehicles. Loading is easy from the get-go, and the worker-friendly low step-in height
dispenses with the need for an intermediate step.
AN OPEN-AND-SHUT CASE FOR PARTITIONS. This comprehensive urban package offers surprisingly large options, starting with available partitions
for the interior of Cargo Van. The standard layout gives you unimpeded access to the rear from the front compartment. For the many business and industrial
purposes where greater privacy or security is needed, we’ve engineered two solutions. Both the solid partition and the partition with sliding window are
constructed of steel, and both fit flush with the flat floor, the side panel and the roof interfaces. The rear-facing side is painted White, while the cab side
of the wall is covered with sound-deadening material to provide a comfortable front cabin. It’s a working combination of aesthetics and functional purpose.

CHASSIS CAB/CUTAWAY.
WHERE VERSATILITY IS KEY.
THESE TOUGH RAM PROMASTER® MODELS BUILD ON LONG-ESTABLISHED STRENGTHS. The wind-tunnel-tested aerodynamic exterior
is sculpted art, but the chassis that supports it is industrial-grade from the get-go. Even better: new for 2017 Ram ProMaster Chassis Cab/Cutaway
models is a wider and beefier rear axle that has real-world advantages: it helps enable a robust GCWR that offers remarkable capability.
Here’s where functionality works hand-in-hand with comfort and versatility. Start with a super-low frame height that’s a mere 24.4 inches from the ground;
it enables easy access without a step and invites minimal-angle ramp attachments—design parameters that offer nearly unlimited upfit potential. Built to
the specifications of the 3500 weight class, these powerhouses come in 136- and 159-inch wheelbases, and feature a maximum 244-inch overall length.
Chassis Cab and Cutaway models are rated at 9,350-lb GVWR, with towing up to 5,100 lb* across the board. Payload varies by wheelbase, but maxes out
at a no-nonsense 5,200 lb. Standard suspension is a premium heavy-duty design that features a MacPherson strut front unit; it is a specifically designed
suspension that includes a rear heavy-duty stabilizer bar, making Ram ProMaster an ideal choice for a custom camper. Upshot? From vocation to vacation,
Ram ProMaster is ready to take it all on. Get more at RAMTRUCKS.COM/PROMASTER
